subject: MatlabStan - "Does not look like a proper stan setup"

messages.author: 6ea1844e76ef93fc
messages.subject: MatlabStan - "Does not look like a proper stan setup"
parts:
Hi,

I posted about this issue in the Wiki for MatlabStan, but I'm not sure whether I should have posted here. 

Brief Description of Problem: I'm unable to get MatlabStan to run on my Windows machine (Windows 7 Professional v6.1). I've tried Matlab 2014a and 2015b. When I attempt to run a model (e.g., https://github.com/brian-lau/MatlabStan/wiki/Compiling-Stan-components-from-Matlab), Matlab gives me the following error message: "Does not look like a proper stan setup". I've been able to get this model to run in R on the same Windows machine and in Matlab and R on my Mac machine (OS X 10.11.3).  

Things I've tried/checked:

- Using -mex setup in Matlab...

MEX configured to use 'MinGW64 Compiler (C)' for C language compilation.

- Rtools in is my PATH
 PATH=c:\Rtools\bin;c:\Rtools\gcc-4.6.3\bin; 

- g++ -v

Using built-in specs.

COLLECT_GCC=g++

COLLECT_LTO_WRAPPER=c:/rtools/gcc-4.6.3/bin/../libexec/gcc/i686-w64-mingw32/4.6.

3/lto-wrapper.exe

Target: i686-w64-mingw32

Configured with: /data/gannet/ripley/Sources/mingw-test3/src/gcc/configure --hos

t=i686-w64-mingw32 --build=x86_64-linux-gnu --target=i686-w64-mingw32 --with-sys

root=/data/gannet/ripley/Sources/mingw-test3/mingw32mingw32/mingw32 --prefix=/da

ta/gannet/ripley/Sources/mingw-test3/mingw32mingw32/mingw32 --with-gmp=/data/gan

net/ripley/Sources/mingw-test3/mingw32mingw32/prereq_install --with-mpfr=/data/g

annet/ripley/Sources/mingw-test3/mingw32mingw32/prereq_install --with-mpc=/data/

gannet/ripley/Sources/mingw-test3/mingw32mingw32/prereq_install --disable-shared

 --enable-static --enable-targets=all --enable-languages=c,c++,fortran --enable-

libgomp --enable-sjlj-exceptions --enable-fully-dynamic-string --disable-nls --d

isable-werror --enable-checking=release --disable-win32-registry --disable-rpath

 --disable-werror CFLAGS='-O2 -mtune=core2 -fomit-frame-pointer' LDFLAGS=

Thread model: win32

gcc version 4.6.3 20111208 (prerelease) (GCC)



-make -v

GNU Make version 3.79.1, by Richard Stallman and Roland McGrath.

Built for i686-pc-cygwin

Copyright (C) 1988, 89, 90, 91, 92, 93, 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, 2000

        Free Software Foundation, Inc.

This is free software; see the source for copying conditions.

There is NO warranty; not even for MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A

PARTICULAR PURPOSE.



-I installed cmdstan using  tar --no-same-owner -xzf cmdstan-2.9.0.tar.gz


-I also specified the appropriate path to cmdstan in stan_home.m


Any suggestions on other things that I should try? When I look more closely at the error and trace it back in Matab, it looks like a bin directory isn't getting created that should be there. 


Thanks for any help!

Peter

messages.author: d0d4a852dcbd9f5b
messages.subject: Re: MatlabStan - "Does not look like a proper stan setup"
parts:
I think you still need to build stan. This creates the bin folder. See section 2.2 of the cmd-stan guide. https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan/releases/download/v2.9.0/cmdstan-guide-2.9.0.pdf

Stijn
